description: Preview and, after explicit confirmation, safely merge two Attio deal records using the native beta merge operation. Never merge people or companies, merge more than one pair, or retry an indeterminate native merge. May require explicit user approval from the host. Dry-run defaults to true. Execute requires dry_run=false, confirm=true, and plan_fingerprint from that dry-run. For HTTP 202, wait and call get_record_details with new_record_id later; both original ids are unreadable after native merge.

confirm.description: Required true in addition to dry_run=false to execute

dry_run.description: Preview the field plan without patching, clearing, or merging

keep_from_leftover.description: Attribute slugs whose leftover values should patch the primary

override_linked_mismatch.description: Explicitly allow differing associated person/company records

plan_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint from the dry-run field plan. Required to execute so the pair can be re-diffed

record_id.description: Primary/live deal record UUID that should win conflicts

resource_type.description: Object type to merge. This beta operation executes for deals only; people and companies are reserved for later coverage.

secondary_record_id.description: Leftover deal record UUID to merge into the primary

skip_leftover_attributes.description: Dangerous fill slugs to clear on the leftover before merge

name: merge_records
